_meta.behavior: DATA ONLY. No module reads these rules yet. Building the readiness/fatigue engine is OUT OF SCOPE for this PR.
_meta.purpose: Encodes recovery-rate priors, readiness inputs, and deload triggers for a future FatigueModule/ReadinessModule.

recovery_priors_hours.description: Approximate muscle recovery windows. HEURISTIC and highly individual — flagged low confidence.
recovery_priors_hours.note: Lower-body compounds and older age tend to extend windows. Connective tissue lags muscle.

readiness_inputs.description: Inputs to a composite readiness score. Subjective measures weighted heavily per the research; wearables are supporting evidence with wide error bars.

inputs.note: noisy day-to-day; compare to personal baseline, not universal cutoffs

deload_triggers.description: Deload when planned OR when >=2 autoregulated triggers fire.
autoregulated_any_two: performance drop (e1RM or rep-PR) for 2+ consecutive sessions despite effort
bar velocity at fixed load down ~10% vs. recent baseline
